summary: AR planning: register PH-224 (customer settlement, due/retention open items and read-only aging) and PH-225 next planning slot as ready, freeze the term-row-combination settlement design in spec/ADR-0009, and explicitly revise two named read-only interfaces plus a concurrency test file missing from the old PH-155/156 whitelists; no product code.

tests.evidence: Actual 147 tasks validated after registration; PH-223 done with handoff, PH-224/PH-225 ready, dependencies done.
Post-review rerun after review pass: actual ok=true, changed files all inside BASE allowed_paths (aec8f67..HEAD); see handoff/verification for the recorded command output.

review.reviewer: independent PH-223 planning reviewer (fresh context, read-only; two review rounds)
findings: Round 1 blockers closed: (1) approval must re-derive net/tax/gross from the current line cumulative and reject stale drafts (previously a stale draft could break one-cent conservation); (2) OpenItem/Settlement due_date are required and terms without due_date/release_on are rejected; (3) term coverage now means all approved terms including already consumed ones, so the second UAT-10 retention settlement is not rejected.

Adopted non-blocking clarifications: no external settlement.draft.save command channel and caller amounts are echo-only; canonical settlement projection emits only draft/active (submitted/withdrawn stay private); aging query returns unallocated_receipt_refs=[]; confirmed_line_performance excludes reversed/superseded sources; SourceConsumption is reused read-only without touching core; ADR tail rounding described as cumulative-difference conservation.
Round 2 confirmed the spec/ADR fixes and required only evidence corrections (review status, task count 147, typo), all of which are applied before this verdict.
review.evidence: Reviewer independently recomputed the term-combination formula (50% -> net50000/tax3000, 40% -> 40000/2400, retention 10% -> 10000/600, totals 100000/106000) and random telescoping conservation; checked contract command/query/entity invariants, whitelist equality with tasks.json, DoR/dependencies, and ran the 19 governance tests plus validate_contracts/check_contract_cases/check_fixture (all pass). check/verify-change were blocked only by the pending review before this verdict; both are rerun after it.

deviations: PH-224 whitelist extends the old PH-155/156 whitelists with two named read-only interfaces (contracts.approved_terms_snapshot, delivery.confirmed_line_performance), delivery/urls.py plugin wiring and a concurrency test file; reasons are frozen in ADR-0009 because the old whitelists would force the implementer to read other owners' tables directly or omit PG evidence.

Thin slice deliberately excludes active-settlement reversal, cash clearing, credit/bad debt, AP, invoice, disputes/extensions and opening open items; these stay with their original proposed tasks or a later planning slot.
unverified: No PH-224 product code, settlement app, models, migrations, PostgreSQL concurrency, browser, legacy upgrade, customer UAT or production evidence; none claimed.
PH-224 implementation is not authorized until this planning PR merges into a trusted BASE and the task is ready there.
